about: Placeholder components for hidden parts. `file` is <file>.fbx beside this file; `category` groups the menu; `kind` is the add-on's component kind; `component`, where there is one, names the entry of irsim's component library (configs/components/, AI.12) whose cited mass, heat capacity and heat the part takes. `shape` and `size_m` describe the placeholder that tools/make_placeholders.py builds: box [x, y, z]; cylinder [length, diameter] along `axis`; cone [length, diameter at -axis, diameter at +axis] along `axis`. X is a component's length unless `axis` says otherwise. Every size is an estimate for a typical example. No mass or heat here: those are the person's (or, later, the project's component library, roadmap AI.12).
